checklist.item: The structural deck slopes to drain at 1/4 in per ft (2%) minimum under the membrane, not only at the wearing surface.
checklist.why: Water that reaches the membrane must also drain.

checklist.item: The membrane turns up walls and door sills at least 8 in (200 mm), or the door sill has a pan and the up-turn is noted as an accepted exception for accessibility.
checklist.why: Low up-turns at doors are the classic balcony leak.

checklist.item: Drains are two-level (surface and membrane level) or the edge drips free; overflow is provided.
checklist.why: A drain only at the surface leaves the membrane ponded.

checklist.item: Protection board and drainage layer are shown over the membrane.
checklist.why: Pavers and pedestals damage a bare membrane.

checklist.item: Railing posts, door thresholds and wall claddings are flashed to the membrane without penetrating it on the flat.
checklist.why: Every flat penetration is a leak.

checklist.item: Insulation location, flood test note and the membrane product type are noted.
checklist.why: A flood test before cover is the only check.
